title: Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Moon
description: Replace the boring moon with Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Moon
body:
## 🌙 Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Moon

This project is inspired by the original idea posted on Reddit, where [u/Squirelwithabaguette](https://www.reddit.com/user/Squirelwithabaguette/) showcased a full **“cycle of the Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Moon”** using Minecraft’s copper oxidation stages. So, Imade it!
 
### 📝 Original Idea Credit
This project is based on the concept shared in the Reddit post:  
**“The cycle of the Waxed Lightly Cut Copper Moon”**  
🔗 reddit post: [link](https://www.reddit.com/r/cut_copper_stairs/comments/1jhgrzd/the_cycle_of_the_waxed_lightly_cut_copper_moon/)

### You can freely include it into modpacks
